lines.text: @maya_front sits in her first car, grips the wheel with both hands, takes a breath, and turns the key.
Interior, low angle up at her.

new_beats.text: The engine catches. A grin breaks across @maya_front's face.

writes.note: I added a beat at 3 s where the engine starts and she smiles.

reply.rationale: The shot ends on the key turn, so the added beat gives the payoff: the engine starts and her face shows the feeling. The words are unchanged.
